new_today.title: OSCAR: an omics atlas of paired single-cell ATAC-seq and RNA-seq for decoding cell-specific gene regulation.
new_today.title_zh: OSCAR：一个配对单细胞ATAC-seq和RNA-seq的组学图谱，用于解码细胞特异性基因调控。
new_today.summary_zh: 配对的单细胞染色质可及性和转录组图谱为剖析多种生物过程和人类疾病背后的细胞特异性调控程序提供了强大框架。配对单细胞转座酶可及染色质测序（scATAC-seq）和单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）数据的快速积累，导致迫切需要全面整合这些数据以阐明单细胞分辨率的调控景观。为满足这一需求，我们开发了OSCAR（配对单细胞ATAC和RNA-seq的组学图谱，https://bio.liclab.net/OSCAR/），以整理大规模配对scATAC-seq和scRNA-seq数据，并提供全面的调控注释和分析。当前版本的OSCAR收录了来自30种组织类型的1136个样本的7749898个人类细胞。重要的是，OSCAR整合配对的scATAC-seq和scRNA-seq图谱进行联合细胞聚类和峰-基因连锁识别，并为标记峰和标记基因的调控元件提供详细的（表观）遗传注释，包括超级增强子、增强子、增强子RNA

extra.description: Paired single-cell chromatin accessibility and transcriptome profiles provide a powerful framework for dissecting cell-specific regulatory programs underlying diverse biological processes and human diseases. The rapid accumulation of paired single-cell assay for transposase-accessible chromatin sequencing (scATAC-seq) and single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data has led to an urgent need to comprehensively integrate these data to illustrate the regulatory landscape at single-cell resolution. To address this need, we developed OSCAR (an Omics atlas of paired Single-Cell ATAC and RNA-seq, https://bio.liclab.net/OSCAR/) to curate large-scale paired scATAC-seq and scRNA-seq data and to provide comprehensive regulatory annotations and analyses. The current version of OSCAR catalogs 7749 898 human cells from 1136 samples across 30 tissue types. Importantly, OSCAR integrates paired scATAC-seq and scRNA-seq profiles for joint cell clustering and peak-to-gene linkage identification, and provides detailed (epi)genetic annotations for marker peaks and regulatory elements of marker genes, including super-enhancers, enhancers, enhancer RNAs (eRNAs), common and risk single nucleotide polymorphisms, expression quantitative trait loci, transcription factor binding sites, transcription factor/transcription co-factor binding peaks, Clustered Regularly Interspaced Short Palindromic Repeats (CRISPR)/Cas9 target sites, DNase I hypersensitivity sites, chromatin accessibility regions, DNA methylation sites, chromatin interaction regions, and topologically associating domains. Furthermore, OSCAR provides three online analysis tools, including cell type enrichment analysis, sequence-based peak regulatory analysis, and peak-to-gene linkage analysis. Hence, OSCAR is a useful platform to query, browse, analyze, and visualize cell-specific regulatory programs across diverse human tissues and diseases.

new_today.title: Single-cell landscape of human adipose tissue reveals THBS1 as a potential driver of fibro-inflammation in metabolic disease.
new_today.title_zh: 人类脂肪组织的单细胞景观揭示THBS1是代谢疾病中纤维炎症的潜在驱动因素。
new_today.summary_zh: 脂肪组织的细胞复杂性在代谢疾病发病机制中起关键作用；然而，脂肪功能障碍的机制仍知之甚少。在这里，我们构建了来自一个种族同质队列的人类内脏脂肪组织的单核和批量转录组图谱，该队列具有明确的代谢状态：瘦且糖耐量正常、肥胖、肥胖伴2型糖尿病。单核RNA测序（snRNA-seq）揭示了一个以高THBS1表达为特征的脂肪干细胞和脂肪细胞的纤维炎症亚群，与瘦对照组相比，这些细胞在肥胖和肥胖伴2型糖尿病个体中富集。通过互补的体外（人原代ASCs、THP-1巨噬细胞和Matrigel捕获的成熟脂肪细胞）、离体（小鼠和人类内脏脂肪组织外植体）和体内（功能获得和抗体介导的中和）实验，我们证明THBS1通过巨噬细胞介导的TGFβ激活促进脂肪纤维化和炎症，损害脂肪生成和脂肪细胞功能。抑制THBS1减轻代谢功能障碍脂肪组织中的纤维炎症特征。此外，血浆和脂肪细胞中的THBS1水平与代谢特征相关，包括BMI和HbA1c。

extra.description: The cellular complexity of adipose tissue plays a critical role in the pathogenesis of metabolic disease; however, mechanisms underlying adipose dysfunction remain poorly understood. Here, we constructed a single-nucleus and bulk transcriptomic atlas of human visceral adipose tissues from an ethnically homogeneous cohort with defined metabolic states: lean with normal glucose tolerance, obesity, and obesity with type 2 diabetes. Single-nucleus RNA sequencing (snRNA-seq) revealed a fibro-inflammatory subpopulation of adipose stem cells and adipocytes characterized by high THBS1 expression, which were enriched in individuals with obesity and obesity with type 2 diabetes compared to lean controls. Through complementary in vitro (human primary ASCs, THP-1 macrophages, and Matrigel-captured mature adipocytes), ex vivo (mouse and human visceral adipose tissue explants), and in vivo (gain-of-function and antibody-mediated neutralization) experiments, we demonstrated that THBS1 promoted adipose fibrosis and inflammation via macrophage-mediated TGFβ activation, impairing adipogenesis and adipocyte function. Inhibition of THBS1 attenuated fibro-inflammatory features in metabolically dysfunctional adipose tissues. Moreover, THBS1 levels in plasma and adipocytes correlated with metabolic traits, including BMI and HbA1c. Collectively, our study provides a cellular atlas of human visceral adipose tissues across metabolic disease states and identifies THBS1 as a key pathogenic driver and potential therapeutic target.

new_today.title_zh: 打击账户密码共享后：Netflix 用户人均观看时长逐年减少，股价年内跌超 30%
new_today.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 28 日消息，据彭博社 10 月 25 日报道，与几年前相比，Netflix 用户每月打开应用的天数有所减少，人均观看时长也有所下降。 据介绍，这一趋势始于 2022 年 Netflix 开始打击密码共享行为之后。管理层起初认为这只是短期现象，因为每个账户对应的使用人数减少，但此后这一趋势仍在延续。用户观看时间减少，可能意味着他们认为该服务提供的价值有所下降，或者将更多时间花在竞争对手的平台上。 消息人士指出，Netflix 使用 QPD（Qualified Play Days）指标衡量用户使用应用的频率。2026 年上半年，Netflix 应用的总使用时长仅增长了几个百分点，但这主要原因是用户数量增长，而非单个用户观看时长增加。 为吸引新用户并留住现有用户，Netflix 增加了内容制作预算，并拓展播客、体育赛事直播等业务类别。不过，Netflix 联席首席执行官泰德

extra.description: Recent advances in biological foundation models have enabled new opportunities for data-driven molecular engineering. However, designing programmable RNA devices remains challenging because of the vast, nonlinear sequence-structure-function landscape. Here, we present Ernie-Switcher, a deep learning framework built upon the RNA foundation model (RNAErnie), comprising three coupled components: (i) integration of RNAErnie-derived sequence-phenotype representations for realistic design generation and filtering; (ii) characterization of RNA landscape navigability as a theoretical basis for sequence optimization; and (iii) incorporation of biophysical constraints to maintain optimization trajectories within biologically plausible bounds. We validated Ernie-Switcher using RNA toehold switches. Theoretically, the observed lower bound on threshold navigability (86.4%) of the RNA landscape supports the theoretical feasibility of RNA switch sequence optimization. Experimentally, the optimized toehold switches achieved ON/OFF expression ratios of up to 35-fold in Escherichia coli. Collectively, RNAErnie-guided sequence optimization provides a scalable strategy for engineering high-performance RNA devices. To facilitate broad adoption, we deployed Ernie-Switcher as a freely accessible web platform. The Python code and pre-trained models are available at https://github.com/zhutiblah/Ernie-Switcher and are archived on Zenodo at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21859277. The RNA toehold switch design platform is available at https://ernie-switcher.bioinformatics-syn.org/. Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

extra.description: Abstract Cancer subtype classification based on molecular features is important for characterizing tumor heterogeneity, evaluating patient prognosis, and supporting precision treatment. Multi-omics integration provides complementary molecular information across genomic, epigenomic, transcriptomic, and proteomic levels. However, the high dimensionality of multi-omics data, complex cross-omics relationships, and imbalanced subtype distributions remain major challenges. To address these issues, we propose CALT-GNN, a graph neural network framework that integrates patient-similarity graph learning, cross-attention-based omics integration, long-tail expert classification, and learnable prediction fusion. The framework first constructs omics-specific patient-similarity graphs, learns latent patient representations using graph convolutional networks, and obtains a unified graph through similarity network fusion. A cross-attention branch models complementary relationships between CNA and DNA methylation as source modalities and mRNA expression as the target modality. In parallel, a long-tail expert branch uses Major and Minor Experts with prototype-guided routing to perform class-distribution-aware classification. The outputs of the two branches are subsequently combined using a learnable global weight. Experiments on eight TCGA multi-omics cohorts showed that CALT-GNN achieved competitive or comparable classification performance relative to representative baseline methods and stable performance on Macro-F1 and MCC, which are sensitive to class imbalance. Ablation and subtype-level analyses further supported the complementary contributions of cross-omics interaction modeling and adaptive long-tail expert routing, although the magnitude of the improvements varied across cohorts and subtypes. These results suggest that CALT-GNN provides a methodological framework for multi-omics cancer subtype classification under complex cross-omics relationships and imbalanced subtype distributions.

longest_on_board.title_zh: 基于多智能体深度强化学习的SD-IoT控制器部署
longest_on_board.summary_zh: 物联网(IoT)中激增的流量, 影响了传感器等设备的数据传输。利用软件定义网络(SDN)技术可以优化网络性能, 提高数据传输质量。然而, 物联网中流量等网络状态的不断变化会影响软件定义网络控制平面的性能。研究软件定义物联网(SD-IoT)中的动态控制器部署问题, 以在流量变化时保证控制平面性能。考虑到物联网节点的能耗以及数据传输的特点, 在部署控制器时, 综合考虑延迟、控制可靠性以及能耗的影响, 并将该问题构建为马尔可夫博弈过程。为了同时兼顾单一控制器性能以及控制平面整体性能, 采用多智能体深度强化学习求解该问题。在部署阶段利用动作掩码屏蔽部分节点, 避免将控制器部署在性能不足或者供能不方便的节点。仿真实验表明, 与基于Louvain社区划分和基于单智能体深度Q网络(DQN)的部署算法相比, 所提算法可以更好地找到高性能的部署方案。

longest_on_board.summary_zh: 随着云计算与空天地海一体化通信网络的深度融合, 各种复杂应用场景的出现使得组合服务的种类和数量急剧增多, 结构也变得复杂。在云网融合环境下, 用户移动设备和边缘服务器等硬件能力有限, 能耗问题成为组合服务进行动态重构不可忽略的重要因素。此外, 传统方法并未考虑空天地海不同场景下用户对不同服务质量(QoS)属性需求的差异性, 使得组合服务的交付结果并不令人满意。为了解决上述问题, 提出一种基于多目标粒子群优化(PSO)的组合服务动态重构方法。该方法首先根据重构原子服务的三维空间地理位置和功能进行聚类, 有效解决在云网融合环境下服务规模庞大情况下的搜索空间爆炸问题; 然后通过能耗计算模型得到服务调用的综合能耗, 并将其作为动态重构的优化目标之一, 结合服务的多种QoS属性进行多目标寻优, 最终生成符合用户需求且能耗较低的重构方案。实验结果表明, 该方法在云网融合环境下节约能耗和应对较大候选服务

longest_on_board.title: 基于多信息融合的高速收费站拥堵检测算法
longest_on_board.title_zh: 基于多信息融合的高速收费站拥堵检测算法
longest_on_board.summary_zh: 在高速收费站拥堵检测场景中, 遮挡、阴影、景深等因素严重影响检测算法的精度, 基于单信息的拥堵检测算法无法准确反映收费站真实拥堵情况, 对此, 提出一种高速收费站多信息融合拥堵检测算法。首先采用目标检测算法检测目标区域车辆, 利用图像空间特征计算车道占用率; 其次利用Deep SORT目标跟踪算法与滑动平衡机制进行车流量综合估计, 减少因为遮挡和阴影导致的车辆误检、漏检问题; 最后利用基于光流信息熵的车速估计方法, 降低因景深变化导致的拥堵状态检测误差。通过融合3种不同维度信息得到拥堵指数, 拥堵指数聚类为5种拥堵类别以判断真实拥堵状态, 从而实现高速收费站的拥堵检测。实验结果表明, 在高速收费站拥堵数据集上, 采用多信息融合的拥堵检测算法准确率达到90.4%, 能够实现对收费站拥堵状态的准确检测。
